Projects

enVision is a media project dedicated to presenting knowledge through a thoughtful blend of written articles, visualized data, and documentary filmmaking. It aims to make complex information accessible and engaging by combining editorial storytelling, clear statistical insights, and visually driven narratives.

Through its three core areas—Digital Magazine, Statistics, and Documentaries—enVision offers a multidimensional platform where information is not only shared, but experienced and understood.

GardenGate is a books, stationery, and gifts business designed to offer a new and immersive way of exploring and shopping.

The project blends a thoughtfully crafted physical experience—where visitors enjoy reading, music, and nature-inspired spaces with glimpses of diverse global ambiances—with a seamless digital experience that prioritizes usability, accessibility, and customer needs.

Together, these environments create a calm, engaging, and memorable journey both in-store and online.

Other Projects

Alongside enVision and GardenGate, I have worked on other projects spanning product design, web development, and digital experiences.

They tackle diverse challenges, from improving user flows and information architecture to designing interfaces that balance clarity, performance, and visual identity.

Driven by research and thoughtful design decisions, these projects take an iterative approach, turning concepts into functional, user-centered digital products across different industries.
